messages:
Alex: :rotating_light: Canary rollout 2026-03-15T14:00 -> us-west-2 is showing a latency + 5xx spike. Healthchecks failing on two routes, 5xx ~12% (threshold 10%). KV cache miss rate also up. Thinking quickstop/abort. Anyone able to flip the rollout or the new-path flag?

IncidentBot: [ALERT] Canary health degraded for rollout 2026-03-15 14:02 (id: r-20260315-314). Pager sent to #eng-oncall.

Maya: grabbing timeline. are we seeing errors from model-serving or the proxy layer?

Alex: initial logs point to proxy downstream 502s from quantized-worker pool. stack trace snippet below: ```
2026-03-15T13:59:58Z proxy: upstream 502 /v1/generate
worker-qual: oom? connection reset by peer
```

Jamie: DeployBot shows deploy id: deploy-20260315-314, canary at 5% traffic, rolled out 14:00. If abort criteria hit 10% 5xx we should stop. I'm on the flag console.

DeployBot: deploy-20260315-314 status=CANARY traffic=5% region=us-west-2 commit=cd9a2f

Lee: I'm taking customer impact. Early telemetry: 0.8% of active sessions in us-west saw degraded response times >3s; 0.3% saw failures. Escalate if we can't abort in 5-10m.

Maya: can someone run `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=proxy -c proxy --since=5m` and paste top errors? I'm suspecting a miscompiled kernel for quantized path.

Alex: paste below, trimmed: ```
E0315 13:59:59.123 proxy.go:412] upstream call failed: grpc: connection unavailable
E0315 14:00:01.456 proxy.go:418] response 502 for /v1/stream
```

Jamie: I'm on the flag console now. Suggestion: toggle feature flag `new-text-path` -> OFF for canary and pause rollout. That should route traffic to the stable path. Anybody object?

Lee: +1 for kill-switch. Notify customers after we confirm rollback.

Alex: doing it now. command: `redwoodctl flags toggle new-text-path --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --value=false --reason="canary 5xx spike"`

Alex: command output: `OK: flag new-text-path disabled for region us-west-2 (req_id=5f8c4b)`

Maya: checking metrics after 30s...

IncidentBot: [SYSTEM] Rollout paused by Jamie (ui action) at 14:03. Canary traffic frozen.

Maya: latency down to baseline in 45s, 5xx now 1.1%. KV miss rate trending back to expected. Looks like immediate mitigation worked.

Jamie: leaving a canary quickstop note in the deploy: `quickstop: flag-toggle new-text-path off -> mitigated 5xx spike; rollback on hold pending root-cause.`

Lee: I'll open an incident page and notify customer success /ops. Brief summary: small percentage of users in us-west experienced increased latency and 5xx after canary; quickstop flag toggle mitigated within 1m. No known data loss.

Alex: creating incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident/R-2026-0315-314 (placeholder)

Lee: Customer impact note for the doc: "~0.8% of sessions in us-west affected; visible in chat generation latency and occasional 502s; no PII exposure; no retries were lost (client retries succeeded)."

Maya: next steps: 1) full rollback of deploy-20260315-314 if root cause is in quantized worker binary; 2) reproduce locally with same quantized binary; 3) postmortem link.

Jamie: can we collect heap/oom info from quantized-worker nodes and lock the image tag. I'll block further canaries until we confirm.

Alex: `kubectl get pods -l app=quantized-worker -o wide` -> found 2 pods with recent restarts. Dumping `kubectl describe` to incident doc.

DeployBot: action=rollout_pause user=Jamie deploy=deploy-20260315-314 timestamp=4201234630

Lee: oncall handoff: I'll stay on til 15:00 PT to coordinate with SRE and CS. After that, Maya picks up unless we escalate.

Maya: happy to take follow-up. posting runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/canary-failure

Alex: one more note: we saw an unusual KV cache miss spike on new-path only — suggests a cache key change in the new handler. That might explain the amplification to upstream. Add to RCA checklist.

Lee: FYI tagged #customers-alert when we have the final postmortem summary. For now: action items assigned: Alex (logs + dumps), Jamie (flagging + freeze), Maya (reproduce + root cause), Lee (incident doc + customer comms).

Jamie: adding a short message to DeployBot: `freeze canary for deploy-20260315-314`.

DeployBot: freeze recorded.

Alex: Thanks team. Leaving heartbeat: :thumbsup: Will update incident doc and ping when we have root cause.

Maya: good catch everyone. Marking this thread as the quickstop coordination channel.

Lee: handing off to Maya at 15:00 PT.

Alex: closing realtime action; will follow up in incident doc and postmortem.
